title: Broadcast management
description: Configure the 1P/2P names and score fields shown on the overlay.
currentDisplayDescription: Names and scores currently shown on the OBS overlay
setNamesDescription: Choose from the player list or enter a name directly.
setScoreFieldsDescription: Enter the scores shown next to 1P/2P on the dashboard and the footer label.
adjustPositionsDescription: Specify the top-left coordinates on the 1920×1080 OBS canvas.
